text: From Sri's decision sheet of 2026-10-17 (relay note in BRIEF.md, addendum "2026-10-17: Olympus"), decision 5, worded as on the sheet: Should Athena keep an ontology? A small shared vocabulary, grown from misreads. Defined terms and how they relate, each with its source, in one file that agents read and checks can use. A term is added when it causes a misread. The study keeps its own concept model, so firstmate, Hermes Agent and Athena are compared in the same terms.
